subject: Errors in JASP, possibly due to underlying errors in lavaan?

messages.subject: Errors in JASP, possibly due to underlying errors in lavaan?
parts:
In JASP:

When I do a mediation analysis, using Bootstrap (Percentile) with 

Two predictors, one mediator, one dependent, 

I get the following Error message.

Does this error reside in JASP, or the underlying lavaan? If the latter, can anyone think of a way to get around what is going wrong? Or explain what is actually going wrong? Thank you.
